# contract-legal-review

> Public Chinese contract legal review skill. Read SKILL.md first, download the complete repository, then run its local Python scripts. Python 3.10+; pypdf is optional for PDFs. This is a fixed three-law snapshot.

## Entry points
- [Skill instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/SKILL.md)
- [Human installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/README.md)
- [Full repository ZIP](https://github.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)

## References

## Scripts
- [Contract extraction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/scripts/extract_contract.py)
- [Law search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/827827sy-design/contract-legal-review/main/scripts/search_law.py)
